name: Ahnelle
source:
Ahnelle – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and a Aegisologist class mentor.

Ahnelle is a young adult dark-grey blue-eyed om'verai with a white mane with a hair clip. Ahnelle's elly is voered with white plates and wings have black membranes. Ahnelle has a back fin, extended to her nose, as well as 2 black head horns.

Ahnelle is an easy-going married woman. Ahnelle is a No. 1 Alveces' fan and always wants to cuddle him, making an annot being a bit afraid of her. Ahnelle is a big tea drinker. Ahnelle is good in evaluation of non-omverai creatures' skills.

Ahnelle is the only class mentor with a full family.
